About AMA

The AMA Group, is Australia's largest network of accident repair facilities, which currently comprises of over 120 outlets and over 2,200 employees across Australia and New Zealand.

The AMA Group's success is a result of our commitment of providing our clients and work providers with quality and cost-effective repairs, as well as exceptional customer service. Our people is what makes this possible and are therefore our focus. We invest in our people. Creating the leaders of today and developing the skills for tomorrow.

 

About Capital S.M.A.R.T

With over 50 repair centres across Australia and New Zealand, Capital S.M.A.R.T Repairs is the industry leader of the collision repair industry, specialising in small, medium, and larger repairs. We are the pioneers of customer satisfaction and innovation standards, and pride ourselves on providing our employees with safe, supportive, and rewarding working conditions.

About the Role

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced and qualified Insurance Loss Adjustor to join either our AMA Group Solutions or Capital S.M.A.R.T Repairs team to undertake quality workmanship to ensure vehicles are returned to their pre-accident condition. This is a full-time position located in all areas of Busselton WA.

The primary purpose of this role is to be responsible for the timely completion of accurate and comprehensive quotes for accident repairs on vehicles. You will apply your knowledge of motor vehicles and your skills with computers whilst interacting with a range of people. 

Reporting to the Centre Manager this role will work within our large network of repair facilities and you will be provided with stability and opportunity.

Key Responsibilities:
- Providing excellent customer service to clients and work providers
- Accurately quote vehicles in a timely manner and in accordance with average repair cost targets and insurer/company procedures
- Complete quotes as required onsite, off-site and online
- Processing vehicles onsite by carrying out vehicle arrival inspections, including mapping and imaging
- Manage parts for repairs to ensure timely arrival and cost effectiveness as required
- Manage suppliers to ensure additional work is recorded and authorised in a timely manner
- Assist with production management of the centre where required
- Ensure vehicles are repaired to their pre-accident condition
- Hand over completed repairs to customers

- Highly professional and personable

- Excel an advantage but not a necessary

- Ability to meet strict deadlines
- Ability to problem solve and excellent accuracy and attention to detail
- Able to work effectively and collaboratively with the team
- Strong commitment to work in a safe manner
- High attention to detail
- Be reliable, punctual & hardworking

We are leaders in the repair industry and offer
-Team environment

-Career opportunity

•	Qualification as a Diesel Mechanic

SK tes is a global leader in sustainable technology lifecycle services, providing end-to-end IT asset management solutions spanning deployment, decommissioning, reuse and recycling. Operating 40+ owned facilities across more than 20 countries and supporting clients worldwide, SK tes processes and managing large-scale technology assets with a strong focus on security, compliance, and value recovery. Guided by its mission to “securely, safely, and sustainably transform and re-purpose one billion kilograms of assets by 2030,” the organisation leverages innovation and global capability to deliver meaningful outcomes for both clients and the environment.

About the Role

Company: SK TES
Location: While this listing is based in Sydney, SK tes is actively onboarding casual technicians across multiple major metropolitan hubs, including Brisbane (QLD) and Melbourne (VIC).
Job Type: Casual / On-Demand / Shift Work
Salary/Rate: Award Rates Apply (Paid in accordance with the relevant Modern Award)

SK tes is actively expanding our on-demand technology workforce roster. We are seeking motivated Level 1 Desktop Support Technicians for immediate intake into our active casual pool to cover upcoming corporate project surges, shift shortfalls and scheduled technology rollouts. 

Upon successfully passing our technical vetting and compliance checks, successful candidates will be placed directly onto our active casual roster for immediate deployment to Walk-Up Kiosks, Tech Bars and corporate client sites across the region.

Key Responsibilities:

In this role, you will perform primary 1st-level troubleshooting for end-users, ensuring standard hardware and software operations while managing escalations. Main tasks include:

1. Frontline Support: Provide 1st level troubleshooting for end-users at walk-up Tech Bars and service desks. 
2. Ticket Management: Gain experience working with Service Desk ticketing systems, including ticket priority management, logging details, and re-directing escalations to L2/L3 support.
3. Technical Recognition: Conduct basic hardware and network troubleshooting to identify core issues.
4. IMAC Services (Install, Move, Add, Change):
    A). Installation: Configure workstations and laptops with standard desktop images and install standard applications under instruction.
    B.) Move: Manage physical movement of IT assets and test moved assets for stable connection to the network.
    C). Add: Install standard software and operating systems following documented instructions relating to PC and laptop assets.
    D). Change: Maintain accurate documentation and records of changes performed.

Requirements & Qualifications

•  Experience: Up to 2 years of hands-on experience in a frontline IT support or service desk environment.
• Education/Certifications: A university degree in IT/Computer Science, or relevant industry certifications.
• Skills: Competency in basic troubleshooting, excellent communication skills for end-user interaction, and a disciplined approach to following technical instructions.
•  Compliance: Must have full, valid working rights in Australia. Willingness to undergo basic background and police checks is required for secure corporate environments.

What We Offer

• Competitive remuneration package 
• Career progression opportunities.
• Ongoing training and professional development.
• Supportive and collaborative team environment.
• Opportunity to be part of a growing global organisation focused on sustainability and innovation.

•	$85.000 p.a. plus superannuation

Position Overview:
Zencol – We are seeking an experienced and reliable Painter and Decorator to join our construction services team. The successful candidate will be responsible for applying paint, varnish, wallpaper and other finishes to protect, maintain and decorate the surfaces of buildings and structures on our residential and commercial projects.

This role is pivotal to delivering high-quality finishes across our projects. As Painter and Decorator, you will prepare surfaces, apply a range of finishes, and ensure all work is completed to a professional standard, on time and to specification.

Responsibilities and Tasks:

Site Preparation and Safety:

?	Erect scaffolding and ladders, and place drop sheets to protect adjacent areas from paint splattering.
?	Ensure all work is carried out safely and in compliance with relevant workplace health and safety requirements.

Surface Preparation:

?	Prepare surfaces by removing old paint and wallpaper, fixing woodwork, filling holes and cracks, and smoothing and sealing surfaces.
?	Select and prepare paints to required colours by mixing portions of pigment, oil, and thinning and drying additives.

Application of Finishes:

?	Apply paints, varnishes and stains to surfaces using brushes, rollers and sprays.
?	Hang wallpaper, matching patterns and trimming edges.
?	Clean equipment and work areas on completion of each job.

Additional Trade Tasks:

?	Repair windows and replace glass in wooden and metal frames, as required.
?	Lay and repair wall and floor tiles, as required.

Compliance and Industry Standards:

?	Ensure all work complies with relevant legislation, building codes, and workplace safety standards.
?	Stay informed of best practice and industry standards relevant to the painting and decorating trade.

Qualifications and Skills:

?	AQF Certificate III (including at least two years of on-the-job training) or AQF Certificate IV, or equivalent overseas qualification.
?	At least three years of relevant experience may substitute for the formal qualification listed above.
?	Relevant registration or licensing, where required.
?	Proven experience as a Painter and Decorator within residential and/or commercial construction.
?	Strong attention to detail and a high standard of workmanship.
?	Ability to work safely at heights and use scaffolding and ladders.
?	Good communication skills and ability to work well within a team.
?	Reliable, punctual, and capable of working under pressure to meet deadlines.

Benefits:

?	Competitive salary.
?	Employee mentoring program.
?	Professional development assistance.
?	Referral program.
?	Visa sponsorship.
?	Work in a supportive team culture with an established construction services company.

Salary:
The role offers a remuneration package of $85.000 p.a. plus superannuation, full-time, Monday to Friday, day shift.

11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Please submit your CV and a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.

About Us:
Skills and Hands NT Pty Ltd is a Northern Territory-based consultancy focused on workforce planning, talent engagement, and sustainable staffing strategies. We work alongside local businesses to support the development of strong, reliable teams through tailored pathways that align with their long-term goals. Our role is to facilitate practical workforce solutions that help employers attract and retain skilled talent—contributing to the resilience and continuity of operations across the Territory.

About the Employer:
We are supporting a reliable cleaning services business (ABN 19 104 515 123) based in Darwin and surrounding areas, operating across commercial, residential, hospitality, aged care, and Airbnb cleaning. The business is known for quality service, attention to detail, safety, and customer satisfaction. With a growing team and service locations across multiple sites, they are seeking an Office Manager to oversee daily office operations, administration, customer enquiries, staff scheduling, records management, office systems, and general business support.

Key Responsibilities
- Organise and control daily office operations, administrative systems, and workflows to ensure efficient service delivery.
- Allocate and manage office resources, including staff, workspace, equipment, and supplies.
- Supervise, support, and monitor the performance of administrative and clerical staff.
- Coordinate office records, correspondence, filing systems, and basic accounts administration.
- Liaise with managers, external service providers, and professionals to coordinate office activities and resolve operational issues.
- Ensure office equipment, systems, and supplies are maintained and functional.
- Oversee compliance with workplace health and safety (WHS) requirements and relevant legislation, policies, and procedures.
- Support personnel activities including recruitment coordination, onboarding, training, leave records, and performance management processes

Selection Criteria
- Office administration expertise: Demonstrated experience managing office operations, systems, and administrative staff.
- People management: Proven ability to supervise, allocate tasks, and monitor staff performance.
- Organisational skills: Strong time management, prioritisation, and attention to detail across multiple tasks.
- Communication: Clear, professional communication with internal teams, management, and external stakeholders.
- Compliance & WHS awareness: Understanding of workplace policies, WHS obligations, and administrative compliance requirements.
- Problem-solving: Ability to identify operational issues and implement practical solutions.
- Adaptability: Capacity to manage changing priorities in a fast-paced office environment.

Required Experience and Qualifications
- At least 2–3 years’ relevant experience in an office administration or office management role.
- Qualifications at AQF Diploma level or higher in Business Administration, Management, or a related field (preferred).
- Full working rights in Australia.

How to Apply
We are looking for a reliable, organised, and proactive Office Manager to join us and oversee the smooth day-to-day administration and office operations of our cleaning services business.

To apply, please submit the following:
- Resume outlining your work experience and references.
- A short cover letter of no more than 300 words explaining:
- Why you are applying for this position; and
- An example of when you showed excellent service, initiative, or teamwork. Please use the STAR method: Situation, Task, Action, Result.
- A written response of no more than 600 words describing how your skills and experience align with the responsibilities of the Office Manager role. Please structure your example or examples using the STAR method.

* Only complete applications that address all three components will be considered. Incomplete or generic submissions will not be shortlisted.

If you are interested in joining a reliable and growing cleaning services business that values quality, care, safety, and customer satisfaction, we look forward to receiving your application.

Apply online only. Phone calls and walk-in applications will not be accepted.

Applications close: 04 Aug 2026

Codafication is a tech company located just off James Street in Brisbane’s Fortitude Valley. We have developed globally recognised solutions for the insurance and construction industries.  Our mission is to pioneer new ways to make the world simpler - and we are building solutions that streamline experiences for our customers making them more efficient and cost-effective. With deep domain knowledge and client partnerships across the trillion-dollar global insurance and construction industries, we are scaling our products and utilisation across Australia, New Zealand and into North America. 
Check us out at Codafication.com 
About the Role
No day is the same as a Customer Success Officer at Codafication! To succeed in this role you will be flexible in your daily activities, enjoy problem-solving and looking for new ways to help customers achieve success using Codafication’s tools. 

As the voice of our customers, you will play an important role in our business working closely with the Project Management, Business Analyst and Software Engineering teams to manage different projects to success. You will provide clear and empathetic customer service and technical support ensuring clients experience success with Codafication’s product offerings.

Your day-to-day duties will include: 

•	Delivering onboarding, training, coaching, and mentoring for customers
•	Building and maintaining strong business relationships with customers
•	Providing frontline support to customers and management of Jira support tickets
•	Building and maintaining high quality customer-facing materials and repositories (e.g. knowledge base library, FAQs, training packages)
•	Providing feedback, support, and updates to internal stakeholders to optimise the customer experience
•	Conducting workshops, demonstrations, training, and reviews of products with customers
•	Driving adoption and retention, while identifying opportunities for account growth and additional product placement


About you
As our successful candidate, you will demonstrate;
•	At least 3 years of relevant work experience
•	Technical experience would be advantageous
•	Excellent written and verbal skills 
•	Love for problem solving and thrive in a dynamic and fast paced environment
•	Ability to win trust and drive relationships to ensure best outcomes for customers and the business
•	Excellent resource management and planning skills
•	Highly motivated with a desire to learn and grow
•	Ability to resolve customer complaints, enquiries, and conduct basic troubleshooting quickly and efficiently

Life at Coda
•	Brand new Fortitude Valley Office bordering James Street Precinct
•	Quarterly staff functions - Celebrate our success as a team
•	Be recognised and rewarded for your achievements
•	Revitalise Days + Volunteer Leave giving you up to 4 extra leave days a year to do what you love
•	Regular 1-2-1 time with your leader to accelerate your career
•	Genuine career progression
•	Hybrid working environment to promote genuine work-life balance

If you want to be part of a winning team and this role suits you to a tee, I would love to hear from you. We do have an immediate start available however happy to wait for the right person given notice periods. 

Salary offered is $75k to $85k

result.description:
Experienced Machine & Line Operator - Bagging Department at Scoresby     Programmed are seeking experienced and technically minded Machine & Line Operators to join our client at Scoresby for the Bagging Department. Our Client is one of the world's largest snacks companies, empowering people to snack right in over 150 countries.     This role is responsible for operating, monitoring, and maintaining bagging machinery within a fast-paced production environment to ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality output. Requirement is for Day Shift.      Key Responsibilities:  
 
 Operate and monitor bagging line machine 
 Ensure smooth and efficient production line operation 
 Perform basic troubleshooting and report faults as required 
 Maintain a clean and safe working environment 
 Follow all safety and quality procedures 
 
    Requirements:   
 
 2-5 years of experience in a manufacturing or production environment 
 Previous experience operating bagging, packaging, or automated production machinery preferred 
 Strong technical and mechanical aptitude 
 Ability to identify and resolve basic machine faults 
 Good attention to detail and commitment to quality 
 Ability to work day and afternoon shifts 
 Previous food manufacturing or packing experience 
 
    Who are we?     As one of Australia's largest employers, we work with great companies all around Australia and New Zealand to give you the best opportunities to work when and where you want to.    At Programmed, we are committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment which values and respects diverse styles, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.    We welcome and encourage women, people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent and people from diverse backgrounds to apply.  Please  click here  to apply.
